Title: Tag Governance Current State
Content: MemorySmith tag governance is active and user-facing. TagPolicyService reads and writes Data/Policies/tag-policy.json by default. TagGovernanceService computes observed tag usage, policy diagnostics, completions, and approval-only suggestions for casing variants, near duplicates, broad tags, namespace candidates, blocklist candidates, and allowlist candidates. The /memories editor uses tag chips, autocomplete, and draft diagnostics before save. The /tags Tag Manager lets Admin users edit policy mode, plain-tag mode, allowlist, blocklist, aliases, namespaces, namespace cardinality, value kinds, and allowed values while reviewing usage and suggestions. Suggestions are informational until a user edits policy or records; no automatic tag rewrite runs from the suggestion list.
